outcome: Compliance with GBS screening and treatment guidelines
cohort: 249 childbearing women hospitalized between January 2022 and February 2022 at University Clinical Center in Gdansk, Poland
finding: This study found widespread compliance with universal GBS screening but also a low positive and high negative predictive value of antenatal GBS screening.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences between the GBS-positive and GBS-negative groups in mode of delivery.
